name: 风云II（美国版本）
english_description: A wuxia MUD set in Gu Long's jianghu, built on the "Jinyong Qunxiazhuan"/XKX framework — it shares the same adm/obj/master.lpc as siblings jyqxc, jyqxc2, jyqxc2013fwq, and xkx2017. It was previously catalogued as having "entirely different" game content from every other sibling, but a file-level check found that overstated: roughly 30% of its domain files are byte-identical to fy330's (also an XKX-framework game), including the exact room-name skeleton for the central Fengqiuhuang square and Chenxiang Town — both draw on the same underlying Fengyun-world template, each independently re-skinned on top of it rather than built from nothing. Distinctive touches of its own: a registration password rule requiring mixed case plus a special character (matched byte-for-byte by fy330, but stricter than most of this collection), ethnicity selection at signup, wounds that permanently lower a character's HP ceiling instead of just draining current HP, and government constables who — unlike most NPCs in this collection — actively chase fleeing players into adjacent rooms.
